verdict.rationale: Weaviate has no named sandbox feature, but you can build isolated test environments yourself. Options include a local Docker instance with a local embedding model, an embedded Python instance (reported by a community user), or a free-tier cloud cluster. Multi-tenancy isolation and backup/restore of selected collections across storage providers let you copy or separate data away from production. Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox or staging environment feature, guidance on cloning production data into a test environment, and agent-specific safe-testing controls.
